messages.subject: Using Inkscape to edit labels
parts:
Hi All,

This article:

http://blog.carlislerainey.com/2011/09/26/using-inkscape-to-post-edit-labels-in-r-graphs/

shows how using Inkscape to tweak things can be incredibly easy, at
least when you use plot(). I tried to duplicate it using ggplot and I
got really close. Here's what happened:

library(RSvgDevice)

ur <- c(3.8, 3.0, 4.1, 5.5, 5.2, 3.6, 5.6,
7.7, 7.1, 7.5, 5.5, 7.5, 5.4, 4.0, 5.5, 5.8)
mar <- c(4.5, -10.9, 15.5, -0.1, 22.6, 0.7,
23.2, -2.1, -9.7, 18.2, 7.7, -5.5, 8.5, 0.5,
2.4, -7.2)
names <- c("Truman 1948", "Stevenson 1952", "Ike 1956",
"Nixon 1960", "LBJ 1964", "Humphrey 1968", "Nixon 1972",
"Ford 1976", "Carter 1980", "Reagan 1984", "Bush 1988",
"Bush 1992", "Clinton 1996", "Gore 2000", "Bush 2004",
"McCain 2008")

# Here's the original using plot. It works just fine:

devSVG("allelections.svg", height = 5, width = 6)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
plot(ur, mar, xlab = "Unemployment",
ylab = "Margin of Victory",
main = "All Presidential Elections",
pch = 19, xlim = c(2,10))
text(ur, mar, names, pos = 4)
abline(lm(mar ~ ur))
dev.off()

electDF <- data.frame(ur, mar, names)

# This creates a nice SVG file that's easy to edit, but all labels
# near edges are deleted (Stevenson, Reagan, Ford, Bush)!

devSVG("allelections.svg", height = 5, width = 6)
ggplot(electDF, aes(ur, mar, label=names)) +
geom_point() + geom_text( aes(ur+.3) )
dev.off()

# ggsave doesn't lose the labels, but they're all grouped
# together as a single object. No amount of "ungroup" in Inkscape
# will release them:

ggplot(electDF, aes(ur, mar, label=names)) +
geom_point() + geom_text( aes(ur+.3) )
ggsave("allelections.svg", height = 5, width = 6)

# This driver also locks all labels & points together

svg("allelections.svg", height = 5, width = 6)
ggplot(electDF, aes(ur, mar, label=names)) +
geom_point() + geom_text( aes(ur+.3) )
dev.off()

# Same here.
pdf("allelections.pdf", height = 5, width = 6)
ggplot(electDF, aes(ur, mar, label=names)) +
geom_point() + geom_text( aes(ur+.3) )
dev.off()

Any ideas?

Thanks,
Bob

messages.subject: Re: Using Inkscape to edit labels
parts:
With the svg() version, I'm able to move the labels around in Inkscape. I was able to do it by double-clicking the region repeatedly -- each time you do it, it enters another group level. It should also work if you ungroup enough times.

I don't know if it matters, but I'm using R 2.14.0 and the development version of ggplot2 from github.

messages.subject: Re: Using Inkscape to edit labels
parts:
That does it! I had tried "select all then ungroup" repeatedly but
that never worked. The double-click approach does indeed. If you
double-click too many times, you'll find yourself moving individual
letters of the labels but CTRL-Z will undo that. Just to clarify, the
basic ggsave command to an svg file was what I used:

ggplot(electDF, aes(ur, mar, label=names)) +
geom_point() + geom_text( aes(ur+.3) )
ggsave("allelections.svg", height = 5, width = 6)

Much thanks for the help Winston!

Cheers,
Bob
